title: अंश ५ · अध्याय १२

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
धृते गोवर्द्धने शैले परित्राते च गोकुले ।
रोचयामास कृष्णस्य दर्शनं पाकशासनः १ ।
items.tr:
dhṛte govarddhane śaile paritrāte ca gokule |
rocayāmāsa kṛṣṇasya darśanaṃ pākaśāsanaḥ 1 |

items.text:
सोऽधिरुह्य महानागमैरावतममित्रजित् ।
गोवर्द्धनगिरौ कृष्णं ददर्श त्रिदश्श्वोरः २ ।
items.tr:
so'dhiruhya mahānāgamairāvatamamitrajit |
govarddhanagirau kṛṣṇaṃ dadarśa tridaśśvoraḥ 2 |

items.text:
चारयंतं महावीर्यं गास्तु गोपवपुर्धरम् ।
कृत्स्नस्य जगतो गोपं वृतं गोपकुमारकैः ३ ।
items.tr:
cārayaṃtaṃ mahāvīryaṃ gāstu gopavapurdharam |
kṛtsnasya jagato gopaṃ vṛtaṃ gopakumārakaiḥ 3 |

items.text:
गरुडं च ददर्शोच्चैरंतर्द्धानगतं द्विज ।
कृतच्छायं हरेर्मूर्ध्नि पक्षाभ्यां पक्षिपुंगवम् ४ ।
items.tr:
garuḍaṃ ca dadarśoccairaṃtarddhānagataṃ dvija |
kṛtacchāyaṃ harermūrdhni pakṣābhyāṃ pakṣipuṃgavam 4 |

items.text:
अवरुह्य स नागेंद्रा देकांते मधुसूदनम् ।
शक्रस्सस्मितमाहेदं प्रीतिविस्तारितेक्षणः ५ ।
items.tr:
avaruhya sa nāgeṃdrā dekāṃte madhusūdanam |
śakrassasmitamāhedaṃ prītivistāritekṣaṇaḥ 5 |

items.speaker: इंद्र उवाच
items.text:
कृष्णकृष्ण शृणुष्वेदं यदर्थ महामागतः ।
त्वत्समीपं महाबाहो नैतच्चिंत्यं त्वयाऽन्यथा ६ ।
items.tr:
kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa śṛṇuṣvedaṃ yadartha mahāmāgataḥ |
tvatsamīpaṃ mahābāho naitacciṃtyaṃ tvayā'nyathā 6 |

items.text:
भारावतारणार्थाय पृथिव्याः पृथिवीतले ।
अवतीर्णोऽखिलाधार त्वमेव परमेश्वर ७ ।
items.tr:
bhārāvatāraṇārthāya pṛthivyāḥ pṛthivītale |
avatīrṇo'khilādhāra tvameva parameśvara 7 |

items.text:
मखभंगविरोधेन मया गोकुलनाशकाः ।
समादिष्टा महामेघास्तैश्चेदं कदनं कृतम् ८ ।
items.tr:
makhabhaṃgavirodhena mayā gokulanāśakāḥ |
samādiṣṭā mahāmeghāstaiścedaṃ kadanaṃ kṛtam 8 |

items.text:
त्रातास्ताश्च त्वया गावस्समुत्पाट्य महीधरम् ।
तेनाऽहं तोषितो वीरकर्मणाऽत्यद्भुतेन ते ९ ।
items.tr:
trātāstāśca tvayā gāvassamutpāṭya mahīdharam |
tenā'haṃ toṣito vīrakarmaṇā'tyadbhutena te 9 |

items.text:
साधितं कृष्ण देवानामहं मन्ये प्रयोजनम् ।
त्वयायमद्रि प्रवरः करेणैकेन यद्धृतः १० ।
items.tr:
sādhitaṃ kṛṣṇa devānāmahaṃ manye prayojanam |
tvayāyamadri pravaraḥ kareṇaikena yaddhṛtaḥ 10 |

items.text:
गोभिश्च चोदितः कृष्ण त्वत्सकाशमिहागतः ।
त्वया त्राताभिरत्यर्थं युष्मत्सत्कारकारणात् ११ ।
items.tr:
gobhiśca coditaḥ kṛṣṇa tvatsakāśamihāgataḥ |
tvayā trātābhiratyarthaṃ yuṣmatsatkārakāraṇāt 11 |

items.text:
स त्वां कृष्णाभिषेक्ष्यामि गवां वाक्यप्रचोदितः ।
उपेंद्र त्वे गवामिंद्रो गोविंदस्त्वं भविष्यसि १२ ।
items.tr:
sa tvāṃ kṛṣṇābhiṣekṣyāmi gavāṃ vākyapracoditaḥ |
upeṃdra tve gavāmiṃdro goviṃdastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi 12 |

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
अथोपवाह्यादादाय घंटामैरावताद्गजात् ।
अभिषेकं तया चक्रे पवित्रजलपूर्णया १३ ।
items.tr:
athopavāhyādādāya ghaṃṭāmairāvatādgajāt |
abhiṣekaṃ tayā cakre pavitrajalapūrṇayā 13 |

items.text:
क्रियमाणेऽभिषेके तु गावः कृष्णस्य तत्क्षणात् ।
प्रस्नवोद्भूतदुग्धाद्रा रं! सद्यश्चक्रुर्वसुन्धराम् १४ ।
items.tr:
kriyamāṇe'bhiṣeke tu gāvaḥ kṛṣṇasya tatkṣaṇāt |
prasnavodbhūtadugdhādrā raṃ! sadyaścakrurvasundharām 14 |

items.text:
अभिषिच्य गवां वाक्यादुपेंद्रं वै जनार्दनम् ।
प्रीत्या सप्रश्रयं वाक्यं पुनराह शचीपतिः १५ ।
items.tr:
abhiṣicya gavāṃ vākyādupeṃdraṃ vai janārdanam |
prītyā sapraśrayaṃ vākyaṃ punarāha śacīpatiḥ 15 |

items.text:
गवामेतत्कृतं वाक्यं तथान्यदपि मे शृणु ।
यद्ब्रवीमि महाभाग भारावतरणेच्छया १६ ।
items.tr:
gavāmetatkṛtaṃ vākyaṃ tathānyadapi me śṛṇu |
yadbravīmi mahābhāga bhārāvataraṇecchayā 16 |

items.text:
ममंशः पुरुषव्याघ्र पृथिव्यां पृथिवीधर ।
अवतीर्णोऽर्जुनोनाम संरक्ष्यो भवता सदा १७ ।
items.tr:
mamaṃśaḥ puruṣavyāghra pṛthivyāṃ pṛthivīdhara |
avatīrṇo'rjunonāma saṃrakṣyo bhavatā sadā 17 |

items.text:
भारावतरणे साह्यं स ते वीरः करिष्यति ।
संरक्षणीयो भवता यथात्मा मधुसूदन १८ ।
items.tr:
bhārāvataraṇe sāhyaṃ sa te vīraḥ kariṣyati |
saṃrakṣaṇīyo bhavatā yathātmā madhusūdana 18 |

items.text:
श्रीभगवानुवाच।
जानामि भारते वंशो! जातं पार्थं तवांशतः ।
तमहं पालयिष्यामि यावत्स्थास्यामि भूतले १९ ।
items.tr:
śrībhagavānuvāca|
jānāmi bhārate vaṃśo! jātaṃ pārthaṃ tavāṃśataḥ |
tamahaṃ pālayiṣyāmi yāvatsthāsyāmi bhūtale 19 |

items.text:
यावन्महीतले शक्र स्थास्याम्यहमरिंदम ।
न तावदर्जुनं कश्चिद्देवेंद्र युधि जेष्यति २० ।
items.tr:
yāvanmahītale śakra sthāsyāmyahamariṃdama |
na tāvadarjunaṃ kaściddeveṃdra yudhi jeṣyati 20 |

items.text:
कंसो नाम महाबाहुर्दैत्योऽरिष्टस्तथाऽसुरः ।
केशी कुवलयापीडो नरकाद्यास्तथा परे २१ ।
items.tr:
kaṃso nāma mahābāhurdaityo'riṣṭastathā'suraḥ |
keśī kuvalayāpīḍo narakādyāstathā pare 21 |

items.text:
हतेषु तेषु देवेंद्र भविष्यति महाहवः ।
तत्र विद्धि सहस्राक्ष भारावतरणं कृतम् २२ ।
items.tr:
hateṣu teṣu deveṃdra bhaviṣyati mahāhavaḥ |
tatra viddhi sahasrākṣa bhārāvataraṇaṃ kṛtam 22 |

items.text:
स त्वं गच्छ न संतापं पुत्रार्थे कर्त्तुमर्हसि ।
नार्जुनस्य रिपुः कश्चिन्ममाग्रे प्रभविष्यति २३ ।
items.tr:
sa tvaṃ gaccha na saṃtāpaṃ putrārthe karttumarhasi |
nārjunasya ripuḥ kaścinmamāgre prabhaviṣyati 23 |

items.text:
अर्जुनार्थे त्वहं सर्वान्युधिष्ठिरपुरोगमान् ।
निवृत्ते भारते युद्धे कुंत्यै दास्याम्यविक्षताम् २४ ।
items.tr:
arjunārthe tvahaṃ sarvānyudhiṣṭhirapurogamān |
nivṛtte bhārate yuddhe kuṃtyai dāsyāmyavikṣatām 24 |

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
इत्युक्तः संपरिष्वज्य देवाराजो जनार्दनम् ।
आरुह्यैरावतं नागं पुनरेव दिवं ययौ २५ ।
items.tr:
ityuktaḥ saṃpariṣvajya devārājo janārdanam |
āruhyairāvataṃ nāgaṃ punareva divaṃ yayau 25 |

items.text:
कृष्णो हि सहितो गोभिर्गोपालैश्च पुनर्व्रजम् ।
आजगामाऽथ गोपीनां दृष्टिपूतेन वर्त्मना २६ ।
items.tr:
kṛṣṇo hi sahito gobhirgopālaiśca punarvrajam |
ājagāmā'tha gopīnāṃ dṛṣṭipūtena vartmanā 26 |

en_chapter: Parāçara said:—After the inhabitants of Gokula had been saved by the upholding of the mountain Govardhana, the chastiser of Paka (Indra) became desirous of seeing Krishna. Having mounted his huge elephant Airavata, that lord of the celestials, the destroyer of enemies, beheld the mighty Krishna on the mount Govardhana, tending cattle, assuming the person of a cow-boy and encircled by the sons of cow-herds, although the protector of the universe. He saw above his head, Garuda, the king of birds, invisible to men, spreading out his wings to shade the head of Hari. Descending from his elephant and taking him at a distance, Sakra, having his eyes expanded with delight, said to the Slayer of Madhu—"Hear! hear, O Krishna, why I have come here; why I have come to thee; do not think otherwise of it. Thou, O lord, who art the supporter of the universe, hast descended upon earth to relieve her of her burden. Being enraged on account of my rites being obstructed, I sent the clouds to deluge Gokula and they have done this evil deed. By upholding the mountain, thou hast preserved the cattle and really, O hero, I am much pleased with thy wonderous deed. The object of the celestials is, now, I think, accomplished, for with thy single hand thou hast uplifted this chief of mountains. Being commissioned by the cattle, O Krishna, I have come to thee, to honour thee for thou didst save them. At their words, I shall install thee as Upendra and as the Indra of the cows thou shalt be called Govinda". Saying this, Mahendra took a ewer from his elephant Airavata and with the holy water it contained performed the regal ceremony of sprinkling. And as the ceremony was being performed, the cattle deluged the earth with their milk.

Having thus inaugurated Krishna, Indra, the husband of Sachi, again affectionately said—"I have done this at the request of the cattle; hear, I shall speak something else to thee, O noble one, being desirous of relieving the earth of her burden. O foremost of men, a portion of mine, under the name of Arjuna, has descended upon earth—do thou protect him always. He shall assist thee in relieving the earth of her burden. He should be protected by thee, O Slayer of Madhu, like thy own Self".

The Deity said "I know that in the family of Bharata, thy son has been born by Pritha. I shall protect him as long as I shall live on this earth. O Sakra, O Slayer of foes, O lord of the celestials, as long I shall be on this earth, no one shall be able to vanquish Arjuna in conflict. The highly powerful Asura Kansa and Arishtha Keshi, Nāraka and others being slain, there shall take place a terrible conflict, O king of the celestials; know that, O thousand-eyed deity, as what will relieve earth of her burden. Do thou go; it behoves thee not to be anxious for thy son. No enemy of Arjuna shall grow in power before me. For Arjuna I shall render back Yudhishthira and his brothers to Kunti after the great battle of Kurukshetra".

Parāçara said:—Being thus addressed, the king of the celestials embraced Janarddana and having mounted the elephant Airavata again went to the celestial region. Krishna too with the cows and cow-herds came back to Vraja by the way sanctified by the looks of the females of the cow-herds.
